ticket.title: Reduce scripts/reserve-namespaces.sh to a wrapper around outfeed reserve
ticket.description: Once outfeed owns namespace reservation end to end, this repository's script should be a thin wrapper or be deleted outright. Keeping a second implementation means the measured crates.io behaviour (burst of five, ten-minute window, 429 reset timestamp) has to be maintained twice and can drift. Tracked upstream as OF-5.

events.reason: Parked: Blocked on GB-362 in the suite repo: outfeed reserve was added in d2f4df9 (2026-11-05) but is contained in no tag, and crates.io's newest outfeed-cli (0.1.0-beta.7) has no such verb - the only hits for reserve in that tree are unrelated code in clone.rs. Wrapping would therefore depend on a pinned git install of an unpublished command, for a manual once-a-year operation that must be reviewable; outfeed is self-contained, so a release is the only missing piece. Unblock when a released outfeed-cli answers 'outfeed reserve --help'. Two further reasons to wait: scaffold takes names only (no per-crate descriptions) and its --repository default points at github.com/gaugeblock, so the wrapper would not be thin. The crate-list drift this ticket was filed alongside is split out to AF-100 and is actionable now.
